purpose: Complete per-joint/per-channel K1/K2 necessity, dose, sign, timing, and joint-pair sufficiency evidence using immutable formal checkpoint_1500 actors.
scientific_boundaries: This is evaluation-time intervention, not retraining.
All interventions retain the original per-joint [delta_theta, theta_dot] observation and [K1, K2] action channels.
PPO, physics, environment, deterministic actor mode, torque clipping, episode length, and success criteria remain frozen.
Calibration initial states (20264101..20264120) never contribute causal outcome estimates.
Main causal outcomes use disjoint initial states 20264401..20264420.
Twenty episode rollouts are paired repeated initial states; the independent inference unit is the five training seeds.
Per-condition first traces are mechanistic diagnostics; endpoint success effects use all 20 episodes.

conditions.baseline: C11: complete Rroll K1 and K2
conditions.full_C11_channel_interventions: 16 channels x {zero, 0.5x, 1.5x, sign flip, calibrated static mean, calibrated time permutation} = 96
conditions.C11_joint_pair_necessity: 8 joints x simultaneously zero target joint K1+K2 in complete C11 = 8
conditions.C00_joint_pair_sufficiency: 8 joints x simultaneous Rroll K1+K2 transplant into complete R0 controller = 8
